photos.summary: Full sheet pan of portioned raw cookie dough balls packed tight on parchment, ready for the freezer. Double batch visible — ~40+ balls in a dense grid, each with chocolate chips pressed into the top. Kitchen scale in the upper right. Afternoon light, clean shot showing the scale of the double batch.

photos.summary: Evening bagging session — Ziploc bags open on the counter, two already filled with frozen dough balls (8 per kit), empties staged alongside. Sheet tray of frozen dough balls visible upper right. Kitchen scale and gloved hand mid-process. Shows the bake-kit portioning workflow for the freezer.
